title: Keep restored-observation timeout diagnostics available when the live state mutex is held or poisoned
outcome: The existing ReportingTurn timeout diagnostic reports a held/poisoned live-state mutex or an absent session without indefinitely blocking or losing the original timeout context; successful observations and product locking remain unchanged.
acceptance: The existing timeout diagnostic handles an unavailable or poisoned live-state mutex and an absent session without unbounded lock acquisition or a panic under the state lock.
Successful observation behavior, receive timeout, original test assertions and production locking semantics remain unchanged; reuse existing diagnostic/poison handling where applicable.
